title: Godot Editor v. 4.3-stable, Compatibility Renderer, crashes on Debian
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot v.4.3
Not reproducible in Godot v.3.6

### System information

Debian Bookworm , nouveau video driver, NVidia obsoleted card

### Issue description

# Description of a bug (short)
I can start Godot Project manager, file name is Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64
When i create new project with Compatibility Renderer, editor crashes with the following message in console:
